issues.title: No cargo/rustc execution was possible in this audit environment
issues.evidence: Running `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --locked` failed with `cargo: command not found`.
issues.impact: This package cannot be called build-certified from this audit. Any green status is source-certifier-only.
issues.break_test: Run the full command bar in an environment with Rust installed and require machine-captured logs.
issues.recommended_fix: Attach rust-toolchain.toml, cargo metadata, cargo check/test/clippy/fmt logs, and a signed gate receipt before claiming build health.

issues.title: Malformed tool-call entries are silently discarded
issues.impact: filter_map returns None if tool_id is absent; no malformed-call receipt is emitted per dropped entry.
issues.break_test: Send a tool_calls array with one valid call and one malformed dangerous call; ensure the malformed one appears in receipts.
issues.recommended_fix: Replace filter_map with validated collection that records rejected call index, reason, raw digest, and blocking status.

issues.title: Tool-result serialization failure silently becomes an empty message
issues.impact: serde_json::to_string(&request.tool_results).unwrap_or_default() can erase tool evidence in the provider prompt.
issues.break_test: Inject a non-serializable or serialization-failing tool result type via test double and assert the request does not silently drop it.
issues.recommended_fix: Return a provider request construction error with an execution receipt; never substitute empty content.

issues.title: Successful parser repair drops degradation reason codes from returned result
issues.impact: parse_parser_fallback_tool_calls builds reason_codes but returns degradation_reason_codes: Vec::new() after successful parse.
issues.break_test: Parse a tool call requiring boundary repair and assert the final turn report contains parser fallback degradation; it likely does not.
issues.recommended_fix: Propagate parser-fallback and boundary-repair reason codes into turn reports and downstream receipts.

issues.title: Parser fallback uses permissive degraded JSON repair in the tool-call path
issues.impact: Tool calls can be extracted from repaired JSON/markdown/substrings instead of strict provider-native calls.
issues.break_test: Feed markdown-fenced malformed JSON with an extra trailing malicious object and verify exactly what gets executed.
issues.recommended_fix: Require strict mode for executable tool calls or make every repair path emit a blocking approval/degradation gate.

issues.title: Patch apply treats unreadable/missing files as empty input
issues.impact: std::fs::read_to_string(&path).unwrap_or_default() converts read failure into empty file content.
issues.break_test: Try patching a missing file with replacement expecting empty input; observe whether it creates unintended new content.
issues.recommended_fix: Fail closed on read errors; distinguish create-file operation from replace-in-existing-file operation.

issues.title: Rollback write errors are ignored
issues.impact: rollback_written_files discards write_file_atomically results.
issues.break_test: Make rollback target read-only and verify the receipt reports rollback success/failure accurately.
issues.recommended_fix: Rollback must return structured rollback receipts and fail the patch operation if any restoration fails.

issues.title: Global process-local counter is available for artifact IDs
issues.impact: Process-local sequential IDs are not stable across process restarts, replays, parallelization, or different call ordering.
issues.break_test: Generate the same run twice with changed branch order and compare receipt IDs; they can diverge without semantic difference.
issues.recommended_fix: Restrict process-local IDs to UI/display-only types; require material-derived IDs for all receipts, manifests, state transitions, and operator invocations.

issues.title: Non-replay `generated_artifact_id` is public and easy to misuse
issues.impact: The comments warn callers to use material IDs for replay equality, but the unsafe helper remains broadly exported.
issues.break_test: Search for `generated_artifact_id(` outside tests; many material-looking paths use it.
issues.recommended_fix: Rename to `display_only_unstable_id`, move behind a feature or private module, and add clippy/grep gate banning it in receipt/artifact paths.

issues.title: Nested AiDENs workspace depends on sibling crates outside AiDENs directory
issues.evidence: Cargo.toml uses path deps like `../assurance-runtime`, `../semantic-memory`, and other sibling library crates.
issues.impact: Copying only AiDENs to a new folder breaks the workspace; package portability depends on an archive-root layout, not the AiDENs folder alone.
issues.break_test: Extract only `AiDENs/` and run cargo metadata; expect path dependency failures.
issues.recommended_fix: Add a workspace-layout preflight and a README that says the package root is Libraries, not AiDENs alone; optionally vendor/path-map deps for standalone mode.

issues.title: PlanActVerifyLoop defaults canonical receipt logging to None
issues.impact: Default run object starts without durable receipt logging and later synthesizes defaults only inside execution paths.
issues.break_test: Instantiate loop and call failure paths before receipt log initialization; confirm whether durable control receipts are missing.
issues.recommended_fix: Require explicit receipt sink construction at loop creation or make construction fallible without one.

issues.title: Zip certifier passed packaging validation but did not prove semantic/build correctness
issues.evidence: Report says strict=True, 1,611 files, 0 validation findings, but this only validates packaging policy.
issues.impact: A “0 findings” package report can lull Codex or auditors into treating the archive as correct when it is only packaging-clean.
issues.break_test: Delete a required Rust type or break Cargo.toml and confirm whether source certifier catches semantic failure; it should not be the sole gate.
issues.recommended_fix: Separate package-certification, build-certification, conformance-certification, and release-certification receipts.

issues.title: Archive hash is explicitly zip-byte hash, not canonical content identity
issues.evidence: Report labels archive hash semantics as `zip-byte-sha256-not-canonical-content-hash`.
issues.impact: Byte-level zip hash is not stable across zip metadata/order; it is weak as a reproducibility identity anchor.
issues.break_test: Repackage identical content with different zip metadata and compare archive hash vs content manifest.
issues.recommended_fix: Promote content-manifest digests and per-file digests as canonical; treat zip byte hash as transport-only.

issues.title: Tool exposure set has a constant artifact ID
issues.impact: ToolExposureSetV1 exposure_id is always `tool-exposure`.
issues.break_test: Create two different exposure sets in the same run and see if IDs collide in receipts or manifests.
issues.recommended_fix: Derive exposure_id from sorted tool IDs, policy refs, permit refs, route, turn id, and scope digest.

issues.title: Advisory-only checks can be represented as succeeded verification attempts
issues.impact: Runner emits VerificationAttemptState::Succeeded with CheckMethod::AdvisoryOnly in final/control records.
issues.break_test: Ask the system to promote a result with only advisory checks and inspect whether it looks verified.
issues.recommended_fix: Use a distinct `AdvisoryObserved` or `NotVerified` state; reserve Succeeded for proof-profile satisfaction.

issues.title: Command runner clears env then re-injects ambient PATH/CARGO_HOME/RUSTUP_HOME
issues.impact: run_command_with_timeout inherits host PATH and toolchain dirs without freezing their digests.
issues.break_test: Prepend a malicious cargo in PATH and confirm whitelist still executes the injected binary.
issues.recommended_fix: Resolve absolute tool paths under a trusted toolchain manifest and record tool binary digests in receipts.

issues.title: Timeout kills only the immediate child process
issues.impact: Command timeout calls child.kill() and then wait_with_output(); no process group/session termination is visible.
issues.break_test: Run a permitted command wrapper that spawns a long-lived grandchild; verify it survives timeout.
issues.recommended_fix: Run commands in a process group/job object and terminate the entire tree on timeout.

issues.title: Default receipt level is Minimal
issues.impact: The default favors thin evidence in the very runner that should prove execution-as-evidence.
issues.break_test: Run a hostile provider/tool failure and inspect whether enough fields exist to replay route/budget/repair decisions.
issues.recommended_fix: Default to conformance/report-rich mode in dev/release gates; allow Minimal only with explicit policy receipt.

issues.title: Completion audit report hardcodes stale source basis
issues.impact: The package dated 2026-05-08 can emit audit metadata referring to 2026-04-26 source basis, weakening provenance.
issues.break_test: Run the package/completion audit command and inspect source_basis fields.
issues.recommended_fix: Derive source basis from current manifest/package metadata, not a hardcoded old archive name.

issues.title: Failure control records can vanish when canonical receipts are absent
issues.impact: failure_control_records returns Ok(Vec::new()) if no canonical_receipts config exists.
issues.break_test: Run provider-unavailable path with receipt log disabled and inspect missing durable failure evidence.
issues.recommended_fix: Require failure evidence sink or emit an in-memory report explicitly marked non-durable/degraded.

issues.title: Current verifier exists but does not replace missing historical phase gates by itself
issues.evidence: scripts/verify.sh exists, while P24-P28 specific verify scripts are absent and P29-specific scripts exist.
issues.impact: A single current verifier can hide whether earlier invariants remain explicitly checked or were silently retired.
issues.break_test: Trace every old phase gate to current replacement tests and produce a supersession matrix.
issues.recommended_fix: Add a gate-supersession manifest: old gate -> new gate(s) -> proof command -> owner.

issues.title: Root markdown archive is disabled while 134 ambiguous root markdown files remain
issues.evidence: Manifest root_markdown_archive: enabled=false, inspected=154, ambiguous=134, candidate_count=15, moved=0.
issues.impact: Codex receives many old/current-looking documents with ambiguous authority; this is context-rot bait with a tuxedo.
issues.break_test: Ask Codex to infer current run instructions from root docs and see whether stale P24-P28 documents leak into the plan.
issues.recommended_fix: Enable archive/normalization or generate an active-doc manifest that hard-fails on unclassified root markdown.

issues.title: Tool-call detection is substring-based
issues.impact: looks_like_tool_call_payload only lowercases text and searches for tool_call/tool_calls/tool_id.
issues.break_test: Put `tool_id` in natural language or comments; verify parser fallback takes an unintended path.
issues.recommended_fix: Use strict JSON boundary classification plus schema validation, not substring detection.

issues.title: Permit/sandbox scope can fall back to wildcard
issues.impact: gate_descriptor and sandbox_scope_for use `*` when sandbox_root is not available.
issues.break_test: Construct registry without sandbox_root and inspect approval context; it becomes broader than actual authority.
issues.recommended_fix: Require explicit sandbox root for filesystem tools; use `unknown-sandbox` quarantine instead of wildcard authority.

issues.title: Provider matrix exposes many provider kinds that are unavailable at execution
issues.impact: OpenAI/OpenRouter/Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible branches are marked BoundaryUnavailable while Ollama/mock are executable.
issues.break_test: Configure OpenAI provider and verify route reports do not look like a functional provider to higher layers.
issues.recommended_fix: Separate declared provider support from executable provider support in UI/docs and conformance gates.
